character: Dr. Compiler — The Execution Chancellor (approved Option 2)
method: image_gen edits of the approved original design: true opponent-facing three-quarter profile, followed by production near-arm layer separation
canonical_facing: RIGHT for actor.direction=+1; entire rig mirrors for -1
body_native_crop_note: The upper body mesh samples only through x1100; its right sample edge smoothly reaches x1180 over source y715..805 to retain the forward boot while excluding the detached arm cell.
arm_solver: Fixed-length shoulder/elbow/wrist IK calibrated to the painted armor joints. The rigid hand rotates around its wrist; unreachable requested targets clamp to painted reach instead of stretching either sleeve.
far_arm_visibility: A restrained light accent samples only the existing lowered open arm/hand pixels and follows the body transform. No duplicated, moved or newly drawn far hand.
near_arm_crop_note: The arm and finger regions end at x1420, excluding the extra generated gold stub/endcap. The one actual sword handle is rendered below the closed fingers.

phase_choreography.fold: 0.00–0.44 s fold/recoil; hold until 0.50 s; upper torso unfolds by 1.10 s while boots stay planted
phase_choreography.core_flare: 0.40–0.84 s cyan crown/core flare; hold until 1.40 s; fade by 1.90 s
phase_choreography.attached_blade_raise: 0.64–1.16 s real arm and closed fist raise the actual blade; hold until 1.52 s; settle by 2.00 s
phase_choreography.paper_release: 0.92–1.28 s broad trailing paper strips spread; hold until 1.60 s; settle by 2.00 s
phase_choreography.orientation: The side-facing stance and actor-captured direction are retained throughout; no camera-facing pose.

phase_native_review_baseline_before_anat.status: Historical endpoint-only baseline; did not establish fixed limb lengths or final anatomy

final_anatomy_review.scope: All real poses, both facings, two 121-sample phase sweeps; independent painted-joint calibration, actual renderer mapping, rigid hand size, fixed bones and continuous elbow motion. Not combat or victory proof.

final_native_phase_review.scope: Configured native presentation after the fixed-bone correction; not combat or victory proof

rig: Asymmetric side-facing body; rigid crown/core; lower-cloak mesh sway; fixed-length two-bone near arm; rigid closed-finger layer above the one actual sword handle; separate blade pivot; original native decorative windows. Crown and held blade use an emissive canvas while paper/armor keep arena illumination. Combat owns the active sweep and reads the same unmirrored solved grip position.
notes: Cropping happens only in Godot; all generated masters remain byte-identical. Historical front-facing and first-profile atlases are superseded. No external game assets were copied. Combat owns timing, hitboxes, direction lock and active hazards.
